about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a frontend-focused software engineer based in Zurich, working at an international tech consulting firm. My stack revolves around TypeScript and Next.js, though I'm comfortable across the full stack when needed.
about.p2: I write code that's meant to be understood: simple, clear, and to the point. Knowing the right modern tools is what makes the difference between a slow process and a sharp, solution-oriented workflow. For me, keeping things simple isn't a limitation, it's a principle.

items.desc: Data cleanup and visualisation tools for different data analysis use cases for the icon outdoor company, saving hours of work every week and increasing workflow efficiency by 160%.
